Per role, a disposable DOC-030 NDA Contract created through the lab API with a primary Document of 3 Versions (executed designation on Version 2) and further single-Version Documents, and a DOC-030 Knowledge Item with two Documents. Nadia Haddad (Legal Team Member) and Daniel Okafor (Administrator) sign in with passwords; a second session of the same person makes the competing restore; Mei Tanaka (Business User) signs in with a fresh magic link.
scenarios.expected: Archive/restore preserves supported history (Versions, files, primary and executed designations); restore is refused while the owning record is archived and gives a stale-state message after a competing restore. Permanent deletion by an Administrator removes the Document, its Versions and files and the primary reference, keeps the activity record, and is refused after a rename. Other roles cannot perform Administrator deletion; Business Users have no archive, restore or delete controls; no single Version can be deleted.
scenarios.actual: 9 recorded browser steps for this role passed on 067c1646 (sections documents of walkthrough.json). Includes the Business User negative check by Mei Tanaka (seeded Business User on the Contract team, fresh magic link). (1) Archive a Document steps 1-3: open the Documents tab, the Document's Actions menu, Archive; check it leaves the list; turn on Show archived: Row menu offered ["Compare with previous","Mark as executed copy","Add version","Edit details","Move to folder","Mark confidential","Archive"]. Archive removed "archive-main-legal-20260925114020.docx" from the list; Show archived drew "archive-main-legal-20260925114020.docx Primary Archived Draft · theirs v3 Sep 25 Uploaded by Nadia Haddad NH". Read-back: 3 Versions, still primary, executed designation on Version 2, every Version download 200. The Documents repository search (200) did not list it. (2) Restore a Document steps 1-3 on the owning record: Show archived, the row's Actions menu, Restore: Restore in the archived row's Actions menu made it live. With Show archived off its row reads "archive-main-legal-20260925114020.docx Primary No type Draft · ours Draft · theirs Redline · theirs Redline · ours Executed Amendment DOC-03"; read-back keeps 3 Versions, primary, executed designation on Version 2. (3) Archive several live Documents: select their checkboxes and Archive in the selection bar; then, with Show archived on, select both and Restore in the selection bar: Selection bar for two live Documents read "2 selected Move Archive"; Archive removed both rows. With Show archived on, selecting both and Restore made both live again. (4) Restore a Document step 1 and 2 in the Documents repository: Filter, Show archived, then the repository's Restore action: With the Record filter set to C-449, the repository listed its live Documents (3 rows) but not the archived one; Filter > Show archived added "archive-repo-legal-20260925114020.txt Archived C-449 · DOC-030 contracts-c archive-and-delete Legal 20260925114020 Draft · ours TXT 46 byte"; its Restore action made it live (read-back). (5) If restoration is refused because the owning record is archived: archive the Contract (setup), try to restore its archived Document, restore the Contract first, then restore the Document: Archived C-449: no Show archived switch, no Upload, row menus offered ["Compare with previous"]; restoring the Document answered 409 "This contract is archived. Restore it before changing its paper.". After the Contract was restored, Show archived > Restore made the Document live. (6) Restore a Document: a second session restores the same archived Document first; this page selects Restore on its stale row, reads the message and reloads: A second session restored the Document while this page still showed it archived. Restore on the stale row showed "This document is not archived.". After reload it was live. (7) Archive a Document step 1 in a Knowledge Item's Documents section: Archive from the row's Actions, Show archived, Restore: Knowledge Item "DOC-030 contracts-c archive Knowledge Legal 20260925114020": Archive removed "knowledge-b-legal-20260925114020.txt", Show archived showed it marked Archived, Restore made it live. (8) Before you start and Permanently delete: a Legal Team Member looks for Delete in the row menu and the selection bar, and tries a direct deletion: Row menu offered ["Compare with previous","Mark as executed copy","Add version","Edit details","Move to folder","Mark confidential","Archive"] (no Delete). Selection bar offered ["Move","Archive",""] (no Delete). Direct deletion answered 403 "You do not have permission to perform this action."; the Document kept its 3 Versions. (9) Before you start: a Business User on the Contract team reads its Documents in the Portal and tries archive, restore and delete: Team add answered 201; Mei Tanaka signed in with a fresh magic link. The Portal Contract page lists "archive-main-legal-20260925114020.docx" and shows no Archive, Restore, Delete or Show archived control. Archive answered 403, restore 403, delete 403; the archived Document stayed archived.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and technical reviewer; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.
A storage failure during deletion (If deletion fails) cannot be induced on the shared lab and was not exercised; the renamed-Document refusal was.

Removal of derived previews and extracted text is not visible in the app beyond the Version downloads, which answered 404 after deletion. The Audit log was not read; the Contract activity read still named the deleted Document.

The Version Type column was checked for presence (a Type column and a Type control on each Version row); changing a Version's type belongs to document-versions and was not exercised, as the technical review allows.
